title: Rod Serling's film and the footage Edwards AFB promised

tellings.quote: crazy, but um Rod Serling, who happens to be my dad's godfather, and and he made UFOs past, present, and future. So, I think Edwards Air Force Base reaches out to him and like promises him like footage of the UFO.

related.note: It is the same Serling film, UFOs: Past, Present, and Future, and the same claim that a military base offered UFO footage, but this telling names Edwards AFB, where the story names Holloman AFB.

plain: The filmmaker Rod Serling, who Michels says was his father's godfather, made a 1974 film called UFOs Past, Present and Future, and Michels believes Edwards Air Force Base, a military air base in California, contacted Serling and promised him footage of a UFO. Michels tells this himself, from memory, in an episode with a scientist who claims life on Mars was destroyed by nuclear war. If true, it would mean the Air Force itself offered UFO film to a public documentary.
